26.07.2024 F.A. No. 140 of 2024 
Hon’ble Ritu Bahri, C.J.
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for the
appellant. 
 
2. The appellant got married on 19.02.2012. 
He has two children from the marriage, the
daughter is aged 07 years, and the son is 14 
years old. The respondent-wife and children 
are staying in the house, which belongs to the
mother of the appellant-husband. 
3. An attempt can be made for an out of 
court settlement to secure the emotional and 
financial needs of the children by referring the 
matter to the councillors appointed by this 
Court. 
4. Subject to deposit of Rs.20,000/- (rupees 
twenty thousand only) by the appellant￾husband in the Registry of the Court as 
litigation expenses to be paid to the 
respondent-wife, notice of motion be issued. 
5. List the matter on 12.09.2024. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.) (Ritu Bahri, C.J.)

24.11.2025 FA No.140 of 2024
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for the
appellant. 
2. Ms. Sukhwani Singh, learned counsel for the 
respondent. 
3. Parties are present in person today. In fact, the 
children are also present. In the pre-lunch session 
when the matter was taken up, parties were requested 
to speak to each other. 
4. In the post-lunch session, when the matter was 
taken up at 2:25 pm, now after interacting with the 
parties, this Court is of the view that there are less 
chances of amicable settlement between the parties. 
5. Learned counsel for the respondent seeks time 
to argue the case. Learned counsel for the respondent 
also submits that the appellant be directed to pay the 
expenses that respondent has incurred in attending 
the Court today along with the children. 
6. Let the appellant reimburse a sum of Rs.5,000/-
towards the expenditure that has been incurred by the 
respondent in appearing the Court today. 
7. List this case on 17.02.2026 for final hearing.
(Alok Mahra, J.) (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 24.11.2025
